item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Meg & Dia - Monster (HIGH QUALITY)
item.description:
Hi. I have been looking EVERYWHERE over the years for a high quality version of this music video.

Unfortunately, there's like only 1 floating 1080p version, and it was processed COMPLETELY wrong and is filled with ghosting, interlacing, aliasing, and judder due to wrong IVTC/de-interlacing. %70 of the frames are garbled.

I have already downloaded the Vimeo (which was locked behind ID verification lol) and YouTube version, which both use the same .avi file (that I think was once shared here) that has these issues. I couldn't find anything regarding this video. I found like 1 480p vob and it was pretty bad and letterboxed. The 1080p version would be really nice given it was actually remastered to 1080p. but for some reason it was never released anywhere? I exhausted almost all my search methods (yandex, soulseek, btdig... etc).

I understand ProRes will be next-to-impossible, so any good 1080p encode would be nice and enough for me.
